name: Destiny
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly ordains and perfects the destiny of His people, knowing them intimately even before their birth and establishing their purpose according to His counsel (Jeremiah 1:5; Psalms 138:8; Isaiah 46:10). Believers are called to commit their works to the Lord and seek His guidance through counsel and instruction, which leads to wisdom and the fulfillment of their God-ordained destiny (Proverbs 16:3; Proverbs 19:20). God's word is powerful and effective, accomplishing His purposes without fail, assuring that His plans for each life will prosper according to His will (Isaiah 55:11).
